reviewed_by: Codex focused review for overdue in-turn goal handoff
reason: The change supplies an overdue provider instruction and wakes timed subagent waits that begin after the limit, so a long turn can hand off even if it missed both warning thresholds. The selected goal tests cover successive requests through overdue state and parked waits before and after expiry. The selected real-Core goal browser entries cover the operator lifecycle on desktop and mobile.
exclusions: No full suite was authorized. UI and native source are unchanged, so frontend and native unit tests are excluded. Unrelated provider and browser journeys are excluded. The selected browser projects use emulation; no physical device is available. The focused instruction regression uses a fake provider and does not prove third-party provider compliance.
